history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration carry out prompt negotiations and agree with its clients on the services provided and related cost recoveries, to fulfil the reimbursements conditions established in the respective agreements and in the cost- recovery policy and guidelines.
history.administration_response: The United Nations Office at Vienna carried out negotiations and agreed with its clients on the services to be provided as well as related cost recoveries and billed its clients prior to the end of 2022. Going forward, the Office is looking to implement some additional internal measures to ensure this action is taken within the same time frame. The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests for its closure by the Board.
history.board_assessment: The Board verified that the United Nations Office at Vienna initiated negotiations with all its clients, in early December 2022, which contributed to the timely collection of payments related to the cost recoveries associated with the services that the Office would provide in 2023. In addition, the Board noted that the Office had developed a spreadsheet document with data about all its clients, allowing updated information on the follow- up to the negotiations, confirmations and payments. Finally, the Board verified that all client payments associated to cost-recovery services were made at the beginning of the 2023 annual cycle, fulfilling the reimbursement conditions established in the respective memoranda of understanding on service level agreements. The Board therefore considers this recommendation to be implemented.
